title: Expected satisfaction of a three-literal clause
statement: Let $V$ be a finite set and consider a clause on three distinct variables, each appearing either positively or negated, which is satisfied when at least one of its three literals is true. Under a uniformly random Boolean assignment to $V$, the expected satisfaction indicator of the clause is $7/8$.
hypotheses_covered: The clause has an injective scope of three variables
Each of the three literals has a specified polarity
